curriculum.name: call_people_at
curriculum.goal: Given a time, return the list of people on the calls scheduled at that time.
curriculum.gold:
PROCEDURE call_people_at(time:TIME)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE PARENT.WHEN={time}
$v1 = SELECT $v0 WHO
RETURN $v1
END
